name: Educational Video
tagline: Turn a topic, notes, or a study guide into a narrated, animated explainer video — rendered right on your agent's computer.
who: Founders, educators, and teams who want a polished explainer or lecture video without a video editor: onboarding walkthroughs, concept explainers for customers, internal training, or a study guide turned into something watchable.
how: Your agent first asks what the video is about, who it is for, and how long it should be. It writes an intuition-first narration script, reviews it as a first-time student would, then records the narration with an offline voice, builds animated scenes timed sentence by sentence to the audio, renders them one at a time on its own machine, burns in word-by-word captions, and stitches the result into one MP4. You get a playable video tab and a download link. Everything runs on the agent's computer with CPU-only tools — no cloud render, no API keys, no background music.
